description: A/B control: run /pan:focus-design --spike with the SHIPPED command body on the small-repo seed; assert the spec artefact and record cost.
why: Reality check RC19 / plan item R21: five emitted command bodies exceed the Agent Skills recommendation; the August note said a split changes what the agent reads and when, so it must be measured, not assumed. Same seed, same prompt, same mode (--spike: the cheapest full pass); the comparison is artefact presence plus the per-step cost the runner records from claude -p. Run --repeat 2 with both scenarios in one invocation so reps interleave. This is the control arm.

steps.prompt: /pan:focus-design "add a --json flag to bin/cli.js so that `tiny add` and `tiny greet` print a JSON object ({\"result\": ...}) instead of plain text, with tests" --spike
steps.why: focus-design.md Phase 10.1: the spec is written to docs/specs/<feature_name>_featureai.md. --spike skips competitive research, so this is the minimal pipeline; the artefact is the outcome, the recorded costUsd the measurement.
